example.title: Henry Hummel Building, 925 Wisconsin Avenue
example.source: HABS WI-335 (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,22-BOSC,2-)

brief: Narrow two-storey Italianate commercial building faced in coursed stone blocks, one of eleven stone-clad blocks built 1867-1904 along Boscobel's main street. Heavy bracketed sheet-metal cornice with diamond panels, four tall 1/1 upper windows with stone lintels and sills, and a wood storefront with two big display windows, recessed shop door and a separate door to the stair.
